description_en: Queries the role permissions of an agent in the Cloud Customer Service System based on the agent account name
description_zh: 根据坐席账号名称查询悉犀客服工作台坐席的角色权限
name: GetGrantedRoleIds

parameters.help_en: The unique client request ID for idempotence verification. You can use a UUID to generate this ID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service. You can view the instance ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The agent account name, which is unique within the instance (logon name)
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称，实例内唯一（登录名）
parameters.name: account_name
